## Anzellini et al. (2019), BM3

`ruthenium_anzellini_2019_bm3_1` · Executable

Reproduction: **close** · [Reconstruction report](../reconstruction-reports/ruthenium.md#record-ruthenium_anzellini_2019_bm3_1)

Automatic selection for equilibrium calculations.

| Component | Parameter | Value | Reported error | Fixed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary | V0 | 27.122 | 0.006 | Not listed |
| Primary | K0 | 323.4 | 1.1 | Not listed |
| Primary | K0\_prime | 4.15 | 0.019 | Not listed |

- **Origin of the parameterization:** experimental
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Anzellini; Errandonea; Cazorla; MacLeod; Monteseguro; Boccato; Bandiello; Anichtchenko; Popescu; Beavers
    - **Year:** 2019
    - **Title:** Thermal equation of state of ruthenium characterized by resistively heated diamond anvil cell
    - **Source:** Sci. Rep.
    - **Volume:** 9
    - **Locator:** 14459
    - **DOI:** 10.1038/s41598-019-51037-8
- **Reference temperature (K):** 300.0
- **Reported pressure coverage (GPa):** \[0.0, 151.0\]

Experimental helium-medium BM3 fit to 151 GPa; the paper reports V0=27.122(6) A^3, K0=323.4(1.1) GPa, and K0'=4.150(19).
